notes: Per point and arm, every scheduled draw is in the denominator. A draw is one whole workflow: the shared proposal, then whatever model calls its arm makes (none, for A and B at a valid proposal).

Intervals are Wilson 95% score intervals for a proportion and Newcombe hybrid score intervals for a difference. They are descriptive: each treats a point's draws as independent repetitions of one workflow, which V0.10a does not establish. At a valid proposal A and B make no model call, so their draws repeat one deterministic result.
The primary comparison is C − B; the secondary B − A.

Financial evidence v1's definitions, unchanged, at the recorded state; a refused or failed workflow submits nothing. Long-run outcomes under the fixed suffix are a mechanics check and are not attributed to any arm.
